'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Allen Gaible DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Allen Gaible]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
